lead: Voyager 1 and 2, launched in 1977, are the farthest objects people have ever made. This shows where they are right now.
try: Press Send Voyager 1 a message now to see when it would arrive.
points: Voyager 1 is so far away that a radio message takes almost a whole day to reach it.
Both have left the Sun's bubble and are now in the space between the stars.
Their power is slowly running out, so instruments are switched off one by one.
